record.reason: Automatic speech recognition models are audited for demographic fairness at full precision, yet the models that ship to production have been quantized, pruned, and distilled. We ask whether post-training weight compression, which alters model weights rather than the audio signal or its feature representation, redistributes error burden across demographic groups.
